summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan adopting resolution (a) from the research report: check-extension-docs.sh and sync-manifest-scripts.sh will run from their source-store path with no environment override, via an opt-in flag gating a new self-correcting branch inside deploy-root-guard.sh's existing refusal path (accepting a git toplevel only when it structurally contains agent-system/extensions). verify-deploy.sh gets only a clarifying header note, since research established it never carried the refusal. Phase 4 is the final full-gate phase covering redeploy plus the complete verify-deploy.sh and run-all.sh sweep. Two issue-log entries were recorded: a win for the research handoff, and a minor design issue noting the report's suggested helper-function shape was not realizable as stated.

artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan for the source-store invocation contract, 3.25h, 3 dependency waves.
